plan.title: Read-only functional QA audit of OneClarity web platform (https://oneclarity.ai)
acceptance_criteria: Given the OneClarity origin, When the main pages load, Then they should render without unhandled errors and within an acceptable load time.
Given the homepage and primary navigation, When navigation is used, Then the expected pages load and navigation transitions occur without errors.

Given the login interface is present, When credentials are entered (valid or invalid) in read-only mode, Then authentication attempts should not create or modify data, and appropriate messages or redirects (if applicable) should appear without side effects.

Given the dashboard or main workspace is accessible, When the user views the dashboard, Then the content should render correctly, data should appear as read-only, and there should be no incorrect UI states.
Given the chatbot interface is accessible, When a user interacts with the chatbot, Then messages load, responses appear, and no data is sent or stored in a way that alters production state.
Given the settings area is accessible, When settings are viewed, Then elements render correctly and form fields show current values without allowing edits causing data changes.
Given responsive layouts are tested, When the viewport size changes, Then the UI should adapt to common breakpoints without overlapping elements or hidden content.
Given client-side errors are present, When the page is loaded, Then there should be no JavaScript errors shown to the user and errors (if any) are logged for review.

Given API endpoints are called by the client, When API requests are made during navigation or interactions, Then responses should be successful or appropriately handled as read-only, with no production data mutations.

Given browser network activity is inspected, When requests are observed, Then failed requests or erroneous responses should be identified and reported with reproduction steps, expected vs actual behavior, and relevant API details.

Given the task explicitly prohibits producing production data changes, When any action could cause data mutation is attempted, Then it should be blocked and only read-only interactions should be performed with clear safeguards.

Given any issues are found, When they are reproduced, Then each issue should be documented with reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, screenshot references, relevant API responses, and severity.
